ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: River Colors
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WORLD_RIVER_COLORS_1 (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/, owner 2026-09-06). Vanilla RiverDef has no colour field and WorldDrawLayer_Rivers paints every river on the world map with one shared Color32. This patches WorldDrawLayer_Paths.GeneratePaths (the method WorldDrawLayer_Rivers already calls once per tile, and which already writes a per-vertex mesh colour for the fade-to-transparent path ends) to substitute a colour computed from the tile instead of the vanilla flat riverColor: red at the Contagion's headwaters (AB_OcularForest), brackish green/brown through the jungle (AB_FeraliskInfestedJungle), toxic brown/blue at the dead-river salt termini (Wasteland), interpolated by each river network's own elevation span in between. Scoped to WorldDrawLayer_Rivers only (a __instance type check in the prefix) so WorldDrawLayer_Roads, which calls the same base method, is untouched.
Does NOT touch the propane lake's world-map tint (RUT_PropaneLake) or any other biome's world colour: WorldDrawLayer_Terrain colours every tile from BiomeDef.DrawMaterial, itself built from the biome's own <texture> field (currently World/Biomes/Jawa_SickWater on RUT_PropaneLake per src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Defs/BiomeDefs/RUT_PropaneLake.xml) -- that is a texture-art lever already in the def, not a C# problem, and out of scope for this pass.
